Interface MemoryLayoutManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
RouxEngine
public interface MemoryLayoutManager
The MemoryLayoutManager is the call set that opens, grows, and closes a region. The hot page is the page that currently receives new frames. allocateRegion(String, long) opens a region. growHotPage(String) replaces the hot page. safeFreeRegion(String, boolean) closes a region. defragment(String) is not implemented. setPinned(String, boolean) stores the pin flag on the region. A pin keeps a close from running until the caller forces it. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#MemoryLayoutManager roux-design.md

  • Method Details

    • allocateRegion

      AllocationResult allocateRegion(String regionId, long capacityHintBytes)
      The method opens a region. The capacity hint is not used. The page size comes from the settings.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      capacityHintBytes - The hint is accepted and is not used to size the page.
      Returns:
      The result is an AllocationResult.

    • growHotPage

      AllocationResult growHotPage(String regionId)
      The method retires the hot page and opens a new hot page. A disk region writes the old page before the new page becomes hot. A memory-only region keeps the old page mapped when the resident cap allows it. A failed call leaves the previous hot page in place.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      Returns:
      The result is an AllocationResult.

    • safeFreeRegion

      OperationResult safeFreeRegion(String regionId, boolean forceIfPinned)
      The method closes a region. A pinned region stays open when the force flag is false.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      forceIfPinned - The flag is true when a pin must not block the close.
      Returns:
      The result is an OperationResult.

    • defragment

      OperationResult defragment(String regionId)
      The method refuses to defragment a region. The refusal status is OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      Returns:
      The result is a failure.

    • setPinned

      void setPinned(String regionId, boolean pinned)
      The method stores the pin flag on a region.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the name of the region.
      pinned - The flag is true when the region is pinned.
